name: v268_news12_position_advantage_continuation
hypothesis: If the news12 post-event long/short advantage flag captures underreaction rather than only same-day noise, the indicated advantageous side may continue when the event range and volume shock are muted.
field_notes: best_position_indicator alphaCount=21, advantageous_position_flag alphaCount=27, current_to_moving_avg_volume_ratio alphaCount=4; high-risk because news12 path fields have been weak.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.420 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(best_position_indicator), 60), industry) + 0.280 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(advantageous_position_flag), 60), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(range_to_atr_ratio), 60), industry) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(current_to_moving_avg_volume_ratio), 60), industry), -1)

name: v268_news12_position_advantage_contrarian
hypothesis: The same post-event advantage flag may instead mean same-day overreaction; a contrarian version should work only when range and volume shock are high.
field_notes: Tests sign directly rather than repairing with old open-close/VWAP carriers.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.400 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(best_position_indicator), 60), industry) + 0.270 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(advantageous_position_flag), 60), industry) + 0.190 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(range_to_atr_ratio), 60), industry) + 0.140 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(current_to_moving_avg_volume_ratio), 60), industry), -1)

name: v268_news12_low_tick_underreaction
hypothesis: A favorable post-event side under low tick count and low relative volume may reflect under-distributed information rather than crowded intraday pressure.
field_notes: Uses tick and volume cold fields instead of minutes-to-threshold fields.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.380 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(best_position_indicator), 60), industry) + 0.260 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(position_advantage_flag), 60), industry) + 0.200 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(total_tick_count_pre), 60), industry) + 0.160 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(current_to_moving_volume_ratio), 60), industry), -1)

name: v268_news12_muted_price_advantage
hypothesis: A favorable long/short event-side flag with muted immediate price change and range shock may leave more next-day continuation than events already fully repriced.
field_notes: Combines direction flag with rank-space muted price response; no raw unit subtraction.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.400 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(best_position_indicator), 60), industry) + 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(advantageous_position_flag), 60), industry) + 0.200 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(primary_price_change_pct)), 60), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(range_to_atr20_ratio), 60), industry), -1)
